## Appearance

Lauretta is an eight-year-old child with a serene and plump appearance. She has blonde hair that hangs in two long plaits.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)_

## History

Lauretta Bradley attended a tea gathering at the manse alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), where they enjoyed a wonderful evening with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md). During a church service, the mischievous [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) dropped a caterpillar down Lauretta's dress, interrupting her otherwise faultless behavior that she had maintained at church since she was a six-month-old baby.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Nell Is Invited Out to Tea P1](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXII.
